prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1003; do not mention it.)
text:
This office has been retained to represent our client in connection with injuries sustained in a side-impact collision at an intersection involving your insured. Our client was seriously hurt in the crash and is now undergoing medical evaluation and treatment. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, in writing, or in person.

We request that you immediately provide a certified copy of the declarations page for the policy in question, including the bodily injury and property damage liability limits, and disclose whether any excess or umbrella coverage applies. We also ask that you confirm in writing that your insured and your company will preserve all evidence relating to the accident, including photographs, dash camera or telematics data, witness statements, claim file materials, vehicle inspection reports, and any recorded statements. Please acknowledge receipt of this letter within ten days.
